about:
Industrial Electronic Supply, Inc. (IES) was founded in 1963 in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The company has operated continuously from its Louisiana base for over six decades, serving industrial customers across the Gulf South and beyond.

IES functions as a distributor and solutions provider for industrial electronic components. Its product portfolio spans industrial controls, automation systems, variable frequency drives, power distribution equipment, and instrumentation. The company stocks and supplies brands including Siemens, Emerson (ASCO), Turck, Banner Engineering, Rittal, Weidmüller, and Flowline, offering items such as push buttons, solenoid valves, condition monitoring sensors, RFID readers, vibration sensors, cordsets, power supplies, and pump control panels. IES also provides technical resources, product selection guides, and configuration tools for lines like Flowline level instruments.

The distributor serves a range of heavy and process industries. Its customer base includes aviation, logistics, and maritime operations (referencing Rittal Blue e+ Dynamic cooling units for ports and airports), brewing (highlighting a Texas brewery modernization), oil and gas (pump panels for irrigation and oil fields), power generation and refineries (ASCO solenoid valves for power plants and chemical facilities), and general manufacturing automation. IES also supports water and wastewater applications through level measurement and control instrumentation.

IES emphasizes long-term local presence and stock availability, promoting "exclusive pricing on valves we have in stock and ready to deliver" and offering predictive maintenance and cloud monitoring services through its insight-driven OEE and diagnostics capabilities.
